name: Action buttons meet touch target size and unapproved features are hidden
title: SC-01-04-03 Action buttons meet touch target size and unapproved features are hidden
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

When the resident launches the app
Then all action buttons meet the 48dp touch target accessibility requirement
And unapproved sub-meter features "Sayaç Gir" and "Rezervasyon" are hidden
